prohibitions: treating a research anchor as a verified exact excerpt

rules.event_disposition: All proposed dispositions are candidates and never human decisions.
rules.quran_anchor: Requires human comparison against an authorized Mushaf source before source_verified can become true.
rules.reference_anchor: Arabic anchor text is a research locator aid, not a human-compared source excerpt.
rules.sahih_collection_record: Collection identity is recorded, but authentication_verified remains false until a qualified human records the decision.
